description: Fetch full dataset metadata by UUID key — title, description, citation text, contacts, license, DOI, record count, numConstituents (sub-datasets), and temporal/geographic coverage. Use after gbif_search_datasets or when an occurrence record's datasetKey needs provenance detail. Contacts are capped by contactLimit (default 10); contactsTotal and contactsReturned report the full count.

contactLimit.description: Maximum number of contacts to include (default 10, max 100). Set to 0 to omit contact detail while still reporting contactsTotal — useful when citation, license, and record count are all you need from a high-contact dataset like eBird.

datasetKey.description: Dataset UUID (8-4-4-4-12 hex) from gbif_search_datasets or an occurrence record.

name: gbif_get_dataset

cap.description: contactLimit applied when the list was capped. Raise it (max 100) to see more. Absent otherwise.

citationText.description: Full citation text for academic reference. May be absent.

contacts.description: Dataset contacts, capped at contactLimit. Absent when the dataset has no contacts or contactLimit is 0.

items.description: A dataset contact with role, name, organization, and email.

email.description: Contact email addresses. May be absent.

contactsReturned.description: Number of contacts included in this response (≤ contactLimit). Present when the dataset has any contacts.

contactsTotal.description: Total contacts on the dataset before applying contactLimit. Present when the dataset has any contacts.

description.description: Full dataset description. May be absent.

doi.description: DOI for citation. May be absent.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The datasetKey UUID does not match any dataset in GBIF. `invalid_filter`: datasetKey is not a UUID, or GBIF rejected the request as malformed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

geographicCoverages.description: Geographic coverage descriptions declared by the dataset. May be absent.

description.description: Geographic coverage description (e.g. "Worldwide"). May be absent.

notice.description: How to reach the contacts contactLimit held back. Absent when every contact was returned.

numConstituents.description: Number of constituent sub-datasets. May be absent.

publishingCountry.description: Country code of the publishing organization.

recordCount.description: Occurrence records GBIF has indexed for this dataset, matching the figure gbif_search_datasets reports. Spans every occurrenceStatus: absence records — surveys that looked for a taxon and did not find it — are counted alongside sightings, and on some datasets they are the overwhelming majority. gbif_count_occurrences with this datasetKey answers the other question, defaulting to occurrenceStatus PRESENT, so the two figures are expected to differ rather than one being wrong. Fetched separately because the detail endpoint omits it; absent when that lookup does not return in time.

shown.description: Contacts included in this response when the list was capped. Absent otherwise.

temporalCoverages.description: Temporal coverage ranges declared by the dataset. May be absent.

end.description: Coverage end as an ISO 8601 date-time. May be absent.

start.description: Coverage start as an ISO 8601 date-time. May be absent.

truncated.description: True when the dataset carries more contacts than contactLimit allowed through. Absent when every contact was returned.

title: Get Dataset
